ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Programmatic systems can buy media and generative tools can produce assets, but managers still decide where to take the brand, how to make the message memorable, and how to allocate the budget.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 27,000 advertising and promotions managers employed in 2024, falling to a projected 26,400 by 2034. That is a net loss of roughly 600 jobs, with about 2,100 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $127,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace advertising and promotions managers, but it will reduce standardized planning. Programmatic and generative tools accelerate routine assets and media buying, shifting managers from writing plans toward strategy, client development, channel integration, and attribution. People limited to standard schedules face pressure, while managers with judgment and integration skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Brand judgment: people set the direction.
Strategy integration: people build the full journey.
Client management: people sustain relationships.
Creative review: people apply taste.
Attribution tradeoffs: people make decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for marketing. Systems accelerate standard assets and media buying, while people retain responsibility for brand strategy and integration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard scheduling tasks can be replaced, not strategy roles. People with judgment and integration ability become scarcer as efficiency improves. Managers who only build schedules without thinking face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strategy and data skills from the start of a marketing or communications career. Pure execution is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment early.
Move beyond writing plans toward strategy plus client development. Learn attribution analysis and work toward brand responsibilities.
Highlight projects and outcomes, and specify the industries you have served. Employers value execution.
Do not evaluate candidates only on presentations. Look for strategic thinking. Core staff who can own a brand deserve strong performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools become widespread and standard planning shrinks.
Brand strategy and integration create opportunities.
Managers with sound judgment become more sought after.

body: Advertising And Promotions Managers lead promotion planning for brands and products, coordinating creative work, media, and budgets. They use data and strategy to achieve reach and conversion goals and review campaign performance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Programmatic systems can buy media and generative tools can produce assets, but managers still decide where to take the brand, how to make the message memorable, and how to allocate the budget.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 程序化能自动买量、生成式能出素材，但品牌往哪打、怎么讲成记忆点、预算怎么排，还是经理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年广告与促销经理在岗约 2.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.64 万人，岗位净减约 0.06 万个，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代广告与促销经理，但会压缩标准策划。程序化与生成式把常规素材和投放提速，经理从「写方案」挪向「定策略、经营客户、整合链路、做归因」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准排期的，有判断力能整合的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 品牌判断：方向靠人定。
策略整合：链路靠人搭。
客户经营：关系靠人养。
创意把关：品味靠人审。
归因取舍：决策靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的营销区——标准素材与投放被系统加速，但品牌战略与整合还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「做标准排期」动作，不是「定策略」的岗位。有判断力、能整合的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会堆排期、不动脑的经理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 市场/传媒起步多练策略和数据，AI 时代纯执行在缩，早点练判断。
从「写方案」升级成「做策略 + 养客户」，学归因数据，争取品牌线。
突出带过的项目与结果，写清服务过哪些行业。公司看重落地。
选人别只看 PPT，要看有没有策略脑子。能扛品牌线的骨干，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式普及，标准策划缩。
品牌战略与整合带来机会。
有判断力的经理更抢手。

body: 广告与促销经理主导品牌与产品的推广策划，统筹创意、媒介与预算，运用数据与策略手段，达成曝光与转化并复盘效果。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 程序化能自动买量、生成式能出素材，但品牌往哪打、怎么讲成记忆点、预算怎么排，还是经理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can forecast traffic and issue conflict alerts minute by minute, but controllers still decide what instruction to give and to whom.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 24,100 air traffic controllers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 24,400 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 300 jobs and about 2,200 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $144,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace air traffic controllers, but it will reshape their workstations. Conflict alerts, traffic forecasting, and data automation already handle much of the monitoring, shifting controllers toward decision-maker and final-safeguard roles. As long as crewed aircraft and irregular emergencies remain, control positions require human judgment.
ai_s2_accel: Short-Term Conflict Alert (STCA) provides real-time risk warnings
Traffic forecast models support sector and slot allocation
Digital and remote towers extend control coverage
Automated FDP handoffs reduce cross-position coordination
ai_s2_auto: Automated flight-plan processing and flight-progress strips
Automated archiving and retrieval of radio communications and records
Automatic updates to flight and traffic data
ai_s3_list: Instant decisions: select the safest option within seconds.
Emergency handling: direct go-arounds, failures, and unlawful interference in real time.
Radio communication: issue short, clear, unambiguous instructions.
Overall situational awareness: combine displays, weather, and procedures into one operating picture.
Accountability: withstand responsibility for every instruction's consequences.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means real-time human-in-the-loop decisions remain central. AI processes data and issues alerts, while controllers retain authority for instructions, emergencies, and safety. Stronger automation increases the importance of final human oversight.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure still brings change. Automated handoffs and traffic forecasting are spreading. Future controllers must master decision-support systems and recover when automation fails. The role remains; people who refuse to learn new systems face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The controller path is narrow and demanding. Prepare with science, engineering, civil aviation, English, physical fitness, and psychological resilience. Pass recruitment medical screening and simulator selection first; civil aviation ground roles provide alternatives if selection is unsuccessful.

Master new decision-support systems and automated handoff tools, maintain license recurrent training and ICAO English proficiency, and progress toward flow management, systems development, or instruction rather than remaining in one sector.

Controller entry generally follows unified civil aviation recruitment, leaving limited transition opportunities. Technical support, flow management, and training roles can provide adjacent paths. Demonstrate evidence of high-pressure decision-making through emergency, dispatch, or military experience.
Prioritize resilience, decision speed, and communication quality before education during selection. Ongoing automation training must keep pace with system upgrades to avoid capability gaps.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time aircraft position and track display
Remote visual control of multiple airports

ai_s7_trends: Conflict alerts, traffic forecasting, and automated handoffs become standard, shifting controllers toward decision-maker roles.
Digital and remote towers expand coverage at smaller airports and diversify job formats.
Controllers become the final accountable authority for automated systems, increasing the value of judgment and responsibility.

body: Air traffic controllers monitor and direct aircraft within assigned airspace or airports. They issue takeoff and landing clearances, route instructions, and separation assignments to prevent collisions and maintain efficient traffic flow.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can forecast traffic and issue conflict alerts minute by minute, but controllers still decide what instruction to give and to whom.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把流量预测和冲突告警做到分钟级，但「这句指令怎么下、下给谁」，还得管制员的大脑来拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年空中交通管制员职业诊断在岗约 2.41 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.44 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 14.46 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代空中交通管制员，但会重塑工作台：冲突告警、流量预测、数据自动化已经把「盯数据」的活接走大半，管制员变成「决策者 + 兜底者」。只要天上还有人开的飞机、还有不规则的特情，管制席位就需要人的判断。
ai_s2_accel: 冲突探测与告警系统（STCA）实时提示风险
流量预测模型辅助扇区与时刻调配
数字塔台与远程塔台技术扩展管制半径
自动化移交（FDP）减少跨席协调负担
ai_s2_auto: 飞行计划处理与进程单自动生成
天气信息自动整合与可视化
无线电通话与记录自动存档检索
航班信息、流量数据的自动更新
ai_s3_list: 瞬间决策：几秒内在多个选项中选出最安全的一条。
特情处置：复飞、故障、非法干扰下的临场指挥。
无线电沟通艺术：简短、清晰、无歧义的口令。
整体态势感知：把屏幕、天气、流程拼成全局画面。
责任担当：为每个指令的后果负责的心理承受力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的核心是「人在回路中的实时决策」，AI 能做的是数据处理和告警提示；指令发布、特情处置与安全责任仍在管制员身上，自动化越强，反而越需要人做最终把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：自动化移交和流量预测在普及，「会操作决策支持系统、能在自动化失效时接住局面」的管制员才是未来主力。被淘汰的是学不会新系统的守旧者，不是这个职业。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 管制员通道窄、门槛高，想走这条路要提前准备：理工/民航背景、英语能力、身体和心理素质都要过硬。先通过招考体检和模拟机筛选，再谈后续；落选也别气馁，民航地面岗位是退路。
把新上线的决策支持系统、自动化移交工具玩到精通，保持执照复训和英语 ICAO 等级。往流量管理、系统建设、教员方向发展，别只守着单一扇区。
管制员几乎只走民航局统一招考，转行窗口有限；但空管相关的技术支持、流量管理、培训岗是可行切入点。展示你在高压下做决策的实证（如应急、调度、军事背景）。
选拔时把「抗压 + 决策速度 + 沟通质量」放在学历之前；在职投入要跟上自动化工具培训，否则系统升级会变成人力断层。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 飞机位置与航迹实时显示
多机场远程可视化管制

ai_s7_trends: 冲突告警、流量预测与自动化移交成为标配，管制员向决策者转型。
数字塔台与远程管制扩展中小机场覆盖，岗位形态更加多样。
「自动化系统的最终责任人」定位强化，管制员的判断与担责价值反而上升。

body: 空中交通管制员负责监视和指挥一定空域或机场范围内飞机的运行，发布起降许可、航线指令与间隔调配，防止飞机相撞并保障流量顺畅，是民航安全体系中的关键岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把流量预测和冲突告警做到分钟级，但「这句指令怎么下、下给谁」，还得管制员的大脑来拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can place outbound calls automatically, but collectors still decide how to negotiate repayment and steady a customer's emotions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 166,900 bill and account collectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 149,400 by 2034, a net decrease of about 17,500 jobs, with approximately 13,700 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $46,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bill and account collectors, but it will reduce standard collection work. Automated calling and messaging systems accelerate routine reminders, shifting collectors from working through call lists toward negotiating repayment, managing emotions, exercising compliance judgment, and handling difficult cases. People who only recite scripts face displacement, while those who negotiate effectively and maintain compliance become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Repayment negotiation: people negotiate the plan.
Emotional response: people judge the right approach.
Compliance judgment: people determine the boundaries.
Difficult cases: people respond in the moment.
Rebuilding trust: people handle communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderate-high exposure collection role. Systems accelerate outbound calls, while repayment negotiation and compliance still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Standard outbound calling tasks face replacement, not roles built around negotiation plus compliance. People who negotiate effectively and maintain compliance become scarcer as efficiency rises, while collectors limited to reciting scripts face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in finance or customer service, practice communication and compliance. Pure outbound calling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop negotiation skills early.
Advance from working through call lists to negotiating plans plus maintaining compliance, and learn emotional management and risk control.
Emphasize repayment results and compliance, and describe the types of cases you have managed. Institutions value steadiness and adherence to rules.
When hiring, look beyond a forceful voice to negotiation ability. Core staff who maintain compliance merit higher incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Compliance continues to tighten.
Negotiation skills command a premium.
Intelligent collection systems become widespread.

body: Bill and account collectors contact delinquent customers, verify the reason, negotiate repayment plans, follow up on payments, and maintain collection records and compliance boundaries.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can place outbound calls automatically, but collectors still decide how to negotiate repayment and steady a customer's emotions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动外呼，但怎么谈成还款、怎么稳情绪，还是催收员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年账单与账款催收员在岗约 16.69 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.94 万人，岗位净减约 1.75 万个，年均产生约 1.37 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代催收员，但会压缩标准催收。自动外呼与短信系统把常规提醒提速，催收员从「打名单」挪向「协商还款、情绪应对、合规判断、疑难处理」。真正被挤掉的是只念话术的，有协商力守合规的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 协商还款：方案靠人谈。
情绪应对：火候靠人。
合规判断：边界靠人定。
疑难处理：临场靠人。
信任重建：沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的催收区——外呼被系统加速，但协商与合规还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准外呼」动作，不是「协商 + 合规」的岗位。有协商力、守合规的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会念话术的催收。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融/客服起步多练沟通与合规，AI 时代纯外呼在缩，早点练协商。
从「打名单」升级成「谈方案 + 守合规」，学情绪与风控。
突出回款与合规，写清跟过哪些类型案。机构看重稳和规。
选人别只看嗓门，要看会不会协商。守合规的骨干，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 合规持续收紧。
协商能力溢价。
智能催收普及。

body: 账单与账款催收员联系逾期客户，核原因、谈还款方案并跟进回款，维护催收记录与合规边界。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动外呼，但怎么谈成还款、怎么稳情绪，还是催收员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can score risks and draft documents, but people still set continuity plans, align departments, and organize exercises.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,205,700 business continuity planners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 1,242,000 by 2034, a net gain of about 36,300 jobs, with approximately 108,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $81,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Business Continuity Planners and can make the occupation more stable. AI assists risk assessment and documentation, while people design plans, mobilize departments, organize exercises, and command incidents. Compliance places the greatest value on these human responsibilities.
ai_s3_list: Plan design: people make tradeoffs.
Cross-functional mobilization: people negotiate interests.
Exercise organization: people establish discipline.
Incident command: people make decisions.
Trust building: people build relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: The relatively high AI-exposure rating reflects extensive automation potential in risk scoring and document work. People retain plan design and organizational mobilization, while stronger compliance supports role stability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces documentation and scoring tasks, not the role of building organizational resilience. People with strong mobilization and exercise experience are more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in management or IT and practice communication and project management. Pure document work is shrinking in the AI era, so build mobilization ability early.
Progress from writing plans to managing exercises and implementation. Learn business dependencies and compliance.
Emphasize exercise and recovery outcomes and identify the critical services you supported.
Do not hire on credentials alone. Assess whether candidates can mobilize departments and run realistic exercises.

ai_s7_trends: Compliance keeps demand stable.
Tool assistance becomes standard.
People with mobilization ability are more sought after.

body: Business Continuity Planners identify organizational disruption risks, develop and test recovery plans, and help critical operations resume quickly after disasters or failures.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can score risks and draft documents, but people still set continuity plans, align departments, and organize exercises.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动评风险、写文档，但预案怎么定、跨部门怎么推、演练怎么组织，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年业务连续性规划师在岗约 120.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 124.20 万人，净增约 3.63 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.82 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代业务连续性规划师，反而让岗位更稳。风险评估与文档可由 AI 辅助，但预案设计、跨部门推动、演练组织与事件指挥仍靠人——这些恰恰是合规最看重的人的部分。
ai_s3_list: 预案设计：取舍靠人定。
跨部门推动：利益靠人谈。
演练组织：纪律靠人立。
事件指挥：决断靠人。
信任建立：关系靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光偏低——工具做辅助，设计与推动还留着人的位置，且合规增强岗位稳定性。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：这个岗位本身曝光低，被替代的是「文档与评分」动作，不是「把韧性落到组织」的岗位。有推动力和演练经验的人更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 管理/IT 起步多练沟通与项目管理，AI 时代纯文档在缩，早点练推动。
从「写预案」升级成「管演练 + 推落地」，学业务依赖与合规。
突出演练与恢复成果，写清服务过哪些关键业务。
选人别只看证书，要看能不能推动跨部门、组织真演练。

ai_s7_trends: 合规驱动需求稳。
工具辅助成标配。
有推动力者更抢手。

body: 业务连续性规划师识别组织的中断风险，制定并演练恢复预案，保障关键业务在灾害或故障后尽快恢复运行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动评风险、写文档，但预案怎么定、跨部门怎么推、演练怎么组织，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can tune parameters automatically and predict equipment failures, but operators still detect an unusual odor on site and decide whether to stop during an abnormal alarm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 128,900 Chemical Equipment Operators And Tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 133,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,200 jobs, with approximately 14,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $57,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Chemical Equipment Operators And Tenders, but it will change their focus. DCS automation and AI alerts take over parameter adjustment and condition forecasting, reducing basic operations roles. Machines cannot replace field inspections, exception judgment, and emergency response. Operators who understand processes, safety, and emergencies advance from watching gauges to protecting the plant.
ai_s2_accel: Pilot programs for intelligent inspection robots
ai_s3_list: Field inspection judgment: sound, odor, and seepage are not fully captured by AI sensors.
Alarm evaluation: experience distinguishes instrument failure from a genuine limit violation.
Decisive emergency response: a second's difference in shutdown timing can change the outcome.
Process understanding: know why each parameter needs adjustment.
Safety and environmental discipline: people must follow every procedural step.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure tier. DCS, alarm prioritization, and reporting automate substantial monitoring and adjustment work, while field operations and emergencies remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation reduces basic operations roles but preserves the value of safety and emergency response. The more automated a chemical plant becomes, the more it needs operators who understand the system and protect the site.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study chemical process technology or chemical engineering at a vocational school or college, then begin in operations at a reputable chemical company. Build strong foundations in process principles, DCS, and safety.
Master DCS and AI warning systems, then advance toward lead operator, process technician, or safety officer. Higher-level safety and process credentials reduce automation risk.

A chemical or electromechanical background is ideal. Without experience, complete safety training and certification first. On a resume, name the plants, units, and abnormal conditions you have handled.
Hire for safety awareness before education. Operators who tolerate rotating shifts, diagnose abnormalities, and act decisively stabilize the entire plant.

ai_s7_trends: As DCS and AI warnings spread, operators shift from watching gauges and tuning parameters to field inspection + emergency response.
Rising safety and environmental requirements increase credential and cross-skill expectations, strengthening demand for lead operators and process talent.
Expansion in new energy and advanced materials creates new plants and roles for operators who learn new processes.

body: Chemical Equipment Operators And Tenders operate and monitor reaction, separation, heat-exchange, and other unit equipment in chemical plants. They adjust temperature, pressure, and flow under process procedures, take samples, inspect the field, and respond to abnormal conditions.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can tune parameters automatically and predict equipment failures, but operators still detect an unusual odor on site and decide whether to stop during an abnormal alarm.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动调参数、提前预测设备故障，但现场那股不对劲的气味、异常报警时「停还是不停」的决定，还得操作员来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年设备操作员看护员在岗约 12.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.31 万人，净增约 0.42 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代化工设备操作员，但会改变工作重心。DCS 自控和 AI 预警接管了参数调节与状态预测，基础操作岗在减少；但现场巡检、异常判断和紧急处置，机器替代不了。会工艺、懂安全、能应急的操作员，反而从「盯表」升级为「守安全」。
ai_s3_list: 现场巡检的判断：声音、气味、渗漏，AI 传感器测不全。
异常报警的甄别：仪表故障还是真超限，靠经验分。
紧急处置的果断：停车时机差一秒，结果天差地别。
工艺的理解：为什么调这个参数，靠原理吃透。
安全环保的坚守：规程一步不能省，靠人执行。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当比例的「监控与调节」环节正被自动化——DCS、报警分级、报表都系统化了，但现场和应急还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。被压缩的是基础操作岗，留下的是安全和应急价值——化工装置越自动化，越需要「看得懂系统、守得住现场」的操作员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选技校或大专化工工艺、化学工程专业，毕业后进正规化工企业从操作做起。把工艺原理、DCS 和安全知识学扎实，这是行业安身立命的底子。
把 DCS 和 AI 预警系统用熟，往主操、工艺员、安全员方向走。考更高级别的安全与工艺证书，抗自动化冲击。
有化工或机电背景最好，无经验先过安全培训考证。简历上多写「熟悉什么装置、操作过什么单元、处理过什么异常」。
招人要把安全素养放第一位，别只看学历。能稳定倒班、会判断异常、敢果断处置的操作员，是装置的定海神针。

ai_s7_trends: DCS 与 AI 预警深度普及，操作员从「盯表调参」转向「现场巡检+应急处置」。
安全环保门槛持续提高，持证与技能复合要求上升，主操和工艺人才更抢手。
新能源与新材料产能扩张带来新装置和新岗位，会新工艺的操作员受益。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A GPS-equipped grader can follow coordinates to shape a slope, but the operator must hit the brakes when signs point to a high-voltage utility below.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 489,300 Operating Engineers And Other Construction Equipment Operators employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 507,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 17,800 jobs, with about 41,900 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $58,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Operating Engineers And Other Construction Equipment Operators in the visible future. Construction sites are not controlled factories. Underground utilities, weather, soil conditions, and overlapping crews create constant uncertainty. Fully autonomous machinery must first prove itself in closed mines. Automatic grading, GPS layout, and semi-automated controls already shift the work from pure feel toward data-guided operation with human oversight.
ai_s2_accel: Display depth and slope through excavator guidance systems
Pilot semi-autonomous loaders in closed mines
Use drone surveys to calculate earthwork quantities automatically
Automatically match equipment with tasks through fleet-dispatch systems
ai_s2_auto: Use GPS layout and automatic grading instead of manual staking and measurement
Run automated rollers along preset compaction paths and record data
Automatically collect equipment operating data and generate fuel reports
Automatically report fault codes through remote diagnostics
ai_s3_list: Complex site judgment: responding to underground utilities, soft ground, and high-voltage lines.
Fine control: precise grading, slope shaping, and bucket placement in confined spaces.
Maintenance experience: hearing abnormal sounds and reading exhaust color for early fault signs.
Emergency safety response: acting during sudden collapses or mechanical failures.
Multi-machine coordination: matching pace with spotters, surveyors, and hauling fleets.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places Operating Engineers And Other Construction Equipment Operators in the relatively low AI exposure range. Core tasks still depend heavily on human control and site judgment. The change is how people work: guidance systems handle measurement and grading assistance, while operators shift from physical effort toward precise control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean the work stands still. Operators who read electronic guidance, use GPS data, and coordinate with drone surveys deliver more value. The era of relying only on force and ignoring data is ending.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with vocational school or formal training and earn an operator certificate. Build experience on common machines such as excavators and loaders. Treat mechanical principles, plan reading, and GPS layout as required skills.

Master intelligent guidance, GPS layout, and automatic grading, and learn equipment maintenance. Moving into larger machines, specialized equipment, or fleet management provides a visible path to higher pay.

Begin a career change with certification. Complete formal training, earn an operator certificate, and build actual hours as an apprentice. In interviews, highlight the machines you have operated, earthwork quantities completed, and your safety record.

Assess actual operating hours and incident records, not certificates alone. Reward guidance-system skills and basic maintenance knowledge. Stable projects and skill-based pay retain experienced operators better than day labor arrangements.

Automatically match equipment to tasks and schedules
Automatically generate earthwork quantities and three-dimensional terrain models
Report fault codes and schedule preventive maintenance
Automatically calculate fuel use and productive hours
Compact along planned routes and record pass counts

ai_s7_trends: GPS and guidance systems become standard on new equipment, combining operator feel with data skills.
Infrastructure and municipal projects sustain demand, while skilled operators remain scarce.
Fully autonomous construction starts in closed mines, while people remain the fallback on open sites.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作工程师及其他工程设备操作员在岗约 48.93 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 50.71 万人，净增约 1.78 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工程设备操作员，至少在看得见的未来不会。原因很朴素：工地不是车间，地下管线、天气变化、土质差异、交叉作业，充满不可控变量，完全无人驾驶的工程机械还得先在封闭矿区证明自己。但自动找坡、GPS 放样、半自动控制已经在改变操作员的日常——从「凭手感」变成「看数据 + 兜底」。
ai_s2_accel: 挖掘机辅助系统显示深度与坡度辅助开挖
半自主装载机在封闭矿区试点
无人机航测生成土方量自动结算
机群调度系统自动匹配设备与任务
ai_s2_auto: GPS 放样与自动找平替代人工打桩测量
自动压路机沿预设路径压实并记录数据
设备运行数据自动采集与油耗报表生成
远程诊断系统自动上报故障代码
ai_s3_list: 复杂现场判断：地下管线、松软地基、高压线下的处置。
精细作业手感：精平、找坡、狭小空间的一铲准头。
设备维护经验：听声音、看烟色判断故障苗头。
安全应急：突发塌方、机械故障时的临场处置。
多机协作沟通：跟指挥、测量、车队把节奏对上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业目前被 AI 直接替代的风险很低：核心作业仍高度依赖人的操控与现场判断。变化的不是「要不要人」，而是「人怎么干活」——辅助系统接管了测量和找坡，操作员从体力活转向精准活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于原地不动：会看电子辅助系统、会用 GPS 数据、能跟无人机航测配合的操作员，效率和身价都更高。纯靠蛮力猛干、不看数据的时代正在过去。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行，先读技校或参加正规培训拿操作证，从挖机、装载机这类通用机型起步。把机械原理、图纸识读和 GPS 放样当必修，未来不吃亏。
把智能辅助系统、GPS 放样、自动找平这些新功能吃透，学一学设备维保。往大机型、特种设备或设备管理走，是看得见的加薪路径。
转行从考证开始：报名正规培训拿操作证，先跟机当学徒积累实际工时。工地经验说话，面试时突出你驾驶过的机型、做过的土方量和安全记录。
招人别只看证，要看实操工时和事故记录；把「会用辅助系统 + 懂简单维护」作为加分项。留人要靠稳定项目与技能等级薪酬，光靠日结留不住老手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 408,200 Counter And Rental Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 421,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,100 jobs, with about 45,900 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $38,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Counter And Rental Clerks, but it will reduce standard counter work. Online booking and self-service pickup and return accelerate routine transactions. Clerks shift from processing orders to inspecting vehicles, resolving disputes, and serving customers. Data-entry-only work faces pressure, while workers who inspect carefully and resolve issues are more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Vehicle inspection: people verify condition.
Dispute resolution: people handle disagreements.
Customer service: people answer questions.
Exception response: people make the tradeoffs.
Trust building: people maintain relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate some steps, but people retain responsibility for judgment and final resolution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces standard transaction processing, not vehicle inspection and dispute resolution. Clerks who inspect carefully and resolve issues become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This field is contracting, so develop vehicle-inspection and resolution skills early. Pure transaction processing is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from processing transactions to vehicle inspection and dispute resolution. Learn customer service and compliance.
Highlight error-free transactions and low dispute rates. Rental locations value reliability and clarity.
Do not hire only for speed. Assess attention to detail and problem resolution; strong staff can anchor a location.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service pickup and return are spreading, reducing transaction-processing work.
Vehicle-inspection responsibilities create opportunities.
Clerks who can resolve issues have greater job stability.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「办标准单」动作，不是「验车与纠纷处理」的岗位。有验车力、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

能处置的文员更稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,200 glass machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 15,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with about 2,000 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $45,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is changing fiber production by reducing staffing without eliminating the occupation. Automated controls, machine-vision inspection, and smart scheduling handle parameter adjustments and routine quality checks. Operators shift from watching parameters to managing broken filaments, roller wraps, unusual equipment sounds, and product changeovers. These continuous-production problems still require rapid human judgment and action. Fewer jobs will remain, but operators will advance toward technician and process roles.
ai_s2_accel: AI process-optimization models assist parameter setting
Automated alerts identify broken filaments and roller wraps
Robots assist package handling and spool changes
ai_s2_auto: Automated controls stabilize temperature, tension, and other parameters
Machine vision detects visual defects in fiber bundles
Smart scheduling and automated production-data collection
ai_s3_list: Broken filaments and roller wraps: rapid response in continuous production.
Fault diagnosis: identify causes behind unusual sounds and vibration.
Product changeovers: use experience to set parameters for different products.
Quality feel: assess fibers beyond machine inspection.
Safety and inspection: stay alert beside hot, high-speed equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure as automation spreads. Systems handle parameter adjustment and routine quality checks, while troubleshooting and changeovers still require experience. Roles that only watch machines will decline. Technicians who understand processes and resolve faults become more scarce as work combines operation, process knowledge, and equipment skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still leaves room to advance. Workers who read automation data, understand process logic, and resolve equipment faults are becoming technicians. Automation replaces people who watch machines without learning new skills.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students entering the fiber industry should prioritize chemical-fiber, materials, or electromechanical studies and gain production-line experience through internships. Focus on process principles and automated equipment operation, not only manual work. That is the direction of industry upgrades.

Learn automated control systems, process parameters, and machine-vision inspection. Advance toward machine-setting technician, process technician, or team leader. Systematize experience in filament-break handling and product changeovers to build your strongest transition asset.

The barrier to changing careers is modest. Start as a machine watcher or apprentice, learn the process, and earn a skill grade. Emphasize attention to detail and reliability in interviews. Continuous-production employers cannot afford restless or careless workers.

During automation investments, do not treat experienced operators only as costs to cut. Redeploy them as line technicians and troubleshooting leaders. Build parallel training in operations and process skills. Skill-based pay can reduce turnover.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 3,100 manufactured-building and mobile-home installers employed in 2024, projected to rise to 3,300 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 200 jobs, with roughly 300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $41,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace manufactured-building installers, but it will transform the first half of installation. BIM models can generate installation sequences directly, QR scans verify components, and lifting-plan software runs simulations. These tools end the era of guessing locations from drawings. Yet job sites have no perfect template. Crane angles, wind loads, component damage, and deviations from site construction all require installers to make immediate judgments that AI cannot handle soon.
ai_s2_accel: Scan codes to locate components and prevent reversed or incorrect installation
Laser and total-station assistance for precise alignment
BIM models guide complex connection details
Drones inspect roofs and elevated work areas
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of component lists and installation sequences
Digital verification of drawings and models
Software simulation and briefing for lifting plans
Digital installation records and acceptance documents
ai_s3_list: Lifting direction and field judgment: safety decisions under weather, wind-load, and site constraints.
Structural-connection craftsmanship: on-site control of bolt torque, welding, and grouting.
Deviation coordination: practical experience resolves conflicts between prefabricated components and site dimensions.
Safety awareness: anticipate risks from elevated work, temporary electricity, and overlapping lifting operations.
Multi-trade collaboration: communicate on site with plumbing, electrical, crane, and civil-construction crews.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means software will take over much of the desk-based work involving drawings, lists, and records, but the occupation is highly site-based, limiting AI's practical reach.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not guarantee job security. The real issue is standardized prefabricated construction. As connection processes mature, the value of pure physical labor declines. Crew-leader candidates who read drawings, direct lifts, and understand assembly processes become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study construction at a secondary vocational or technical school, where prefabricated-building installation skills are in demand. Master drawing interpretation, measurement, and safety standards, then join a prefabricated-construction company as an installer and progress to crew leadership within several years.

Improve drawing interpretation and lifting-direction skills and earn prefabricated-construction credentials. Advance from providing labor to directing work from drawings to increase both pay and stability.

People with construction-site, welding, plumbing, or electrical experience transition fastest. In applications, emphasize your ability to read drawings, use power tools, and work safely around lifts instead of offering only a general claim that you work hard.

Do not hire general labor solely by daily wage. Build a pipeline of crew leaders who understand assembly processes and can lead small teams. Prefabricated projects have tight milestones, and one skilled leader can outperform three beginners.

Digital progress, issue, and acceptance tracking

BIM and scanned verification become standard processes, making drawing and digital-tool skills firm requirements.
As standardized connection methods spread, versatile installation crew leaders become more valuable than pure laborers.

吊装方案的软件模拟与交底

ai_s3_list: 吊装指挥与现场判断：天气、风载、场地局限下的安全决策。
结构连接手艺：螺栓扭矩、焊接、灌浆的现场控制。
偏差协调：预制件和现场尺寸打架时的处理经验。
安全意识：高空、临电、吊装交叉作业的风险预判。
多工种协作：与水电、吊车、土建班组的现场沟通。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的案头环节——图纸、清单、记录——会被软件大幅接管，但现场占比高，AI 的实际接触面有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于岗位无忧：真正要留意的是「装配式施工标准化」——连接工艺越来越成熟，纯体力工的价值在被压缩。会看图、会指挥吊装、懂装配工艺的工头型人才反而更吃香。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读建筑类中职或技校，装配式建筑施工方向正缺人。在校把识图、测量、安全规范学扎实，毕业进装配式企业从安装工做起，几年就能带班。
把识图和吊装指挥能力提上来，考装配式相关证书。从「出力的」升级成「看图指挥的」，工资和稳定性都上台阶。
有工地、焊工、水电基础的人转型最快。求职时强调你会看图纸、会用电动机具、能适应吊装作业，比泛泛的「能吃苦」有用。
别只按日薪招普工，要把懂装配工艺、能带小队的工头作为重点储备。装配式项目节点紧，一个熟练工头顶三个生手。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 屋面与高处作业面复查

ai_s7_trends: 装配式施工渗透率持续上升，预制安装岗需求跟随增长。
BIM 与扫码核验成为标准流程，看图与数字工具能力成为硬门槛。
标准化连接工艺普及，复合型安装工头比纯体力工更值钱。

body: 预制建筑与移动房屋安装工负责将工厂预制的房屋模块、墙板、屋顶分段现场组装为成品建筑，包括吊装就位、结构连接、水电气对接与内外饰收口。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 构件清单可以扫码核验，但「这块墙板怎么安全就位」还是人来定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can chat and conduct initial screening, but a counselor still needs to hold the moment when you begin to cry.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 483,500 counselors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 564,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 81,100 jobs, with around 48,300 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $59,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Mental Health Counselors, but it will reshape the front end. AI takes screening scales, self-help exercises, and appointment triage, shifting counselors from initial intake toward deep intervention, crisis management, and therapeutic relationships. Superficial companionship faces pressure, while relationship and intervention skills gain value.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic initial assessment with scales and screening
ai_s3_list: Therapeutic relationship: people build trust.
Deep intervention: people uncover pain.
Crisis judgment: people assess risk.
Boundary protection: people uphold ethics.
Final accountability: people protect safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure tier. Models can take over screening and self-help, while relationships and interventions depend heavily on human presence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure still creates pressure. Superficial companionship, not deep intervention, faces replacement. Counselors who build relationships and manage crises become scarcer as demand rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong psychology foundations and accumulate internships and supervision. Superficial work is contracting, so practice relationship-building and crisis intervention early.
Advance from general counseling toward specialization and crisis management. Learn AI tools and pursue core institutional roles or independent client development.
Highlight supervised hours and specialties and identify modalities used. Crisis-intervention experience is preferred.
When hiring, look beyond credentials and assess stability and boundaries. Counselors who handle crises deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over screening and self-help, shifting counselors toward deep intervention.
Mental-health demand continues to rise.
Counselors with crisis skills and specialties are in greater demand.

body: Mental Health Counselors use interviews and psychological techniques to assess and intervene in emotional, behavioral, and adjustment problems, developing plans and tracking progress within confidentiality and boundary frameworks.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can chat and conduct initial screening, but a counselor still needs to hold the moment when you begin to cry.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能陪聊做初筛，但你说着你哭了的那一下，还是咨询师接得住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年健康咨询师在岗约 48.35 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 56.46 万人，净增约 8.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.83 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代心理健康咨询师，但会重做前端。筛查量表、自助练习和预约分流被 AI 接管，咨询师从「接初访」转向「做深度干预、管危机、守关系」。真正被挤掉的是浅层陪伴，能建关系、能干预的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 量表与筛查的自动初评
预约与分诊的智能分流
ai_s3_list: 咨访关系：信任靠人建。
深度干预：痛点靠人挖。
危机判断：风险要人定。
边界守护：伦理靠人守。
责任兜底：安全要人扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——筛查与自助能被模型接管，但关系与干预高度依赖人的在场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于没压力：被替代的是「浅层陪伴」，不是「深度干预」。能建关系、能管危机的咨询师，反而随需求上升更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 心理底子打厚，在校多实习和受督。AI 时代浅层在缩，早点练关系与危机干预。
从「接咨询」升级成「做专长 + 管危机」，学 AI 工具，争取转机构骨干或开私域。
突出受督时数与专长，写清跟过的流派。有危机干预经验优先。
招人别只看证书，要看稳定性和边界感。能接危机的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 筛查与自助被 AI 接管，咨询师转向深度干预。
心理健康需求持续上升。
能管危机、有专长的咨询师更抢手。

body: 心理健康咨询师通过访谈与心理技术评估和干预个体的情绪、行为与适应问题，制定咨询方案并跟踪进展，在保密与边界框架内帮助来访者改善心理健康。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能陪聊做初筛，但你说着你哭了的那一下，还是咨询师接得住。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can read an OCT image in three seconds, but a technologist must still decide on site how to examine the patient and whether the data are reliable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 178,800 medical technologists were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 188,100, a net increase of about 9,300 jobs, with about 13,600 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $48,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace ophthalmic medical technologists, but it will take over report interpretation and some automated measurements. Technologists remain essential for performing examinations, guiding patient cooperation, controlling data quality, and managing equipment. Because examination quality directly determines the accuracy of AI interpretation, technologists become the data gatekeepers of the AI era.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic lesion marking in AI fundus screening
Widespread adoption of smart refraction and automated measurement devices
Integration of remote image reading and AI-assisted diagnosis
ai_s2_auto: Automated measurement and report generation for OCT and fundus photography
Automatic entry of visual acuity and intraocular pressure data into systems
Examination report templates and structured records
Digital patient scheduling and examination workflows
ai_s3_list: Examination protocol decisions: choosing equipment and adjusting parameters for special cases.
Data quality control: identifying abnormal values and determining whether they reflect disease or error.
Patient guidance: helping older adults and children cooperate for high-quality examinations.
Equipment maintenance: ensuring proper instrument condition and calibration.
Clinical coordination: understanding what physicians need and what data can be provided.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that AI is substantially assisting data interpretation and report generation, while examination performance, quality control, and patient guidance remain core technologist responsibilities. As AI interpretation becomes more common, high-quality data acquisition becomes more important, increasing rather than reducing the technologist's value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Technologists who can use AI screening tools and understand data quality control are valued AI partners for hospitals, while those who only perform mechanical operations without understanding them will be replaced by equipment. Building combined expertise in examinations, quality control, and equipment is the path forward.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Ophthalmic technology offers good value within medicine, with shorter training than physicians and steadily growing demand. Students should consider optometry or allied health programs, master devices such as OCT and fundus cameras, and build quality-control skills for the AI era.

Master AI fundus screening and automated measurement equipment, and strengthen data quality-control skills and experience with special cases. Advancing toward senior technologist, examination-room supervisor, optician, or optometrist roles opens up income and career opportunities.

People with backgrounds in allied health, optometry, or instrumentation can transition relatively smoothly. Earn the relevant credentials first and enter through an examination room at a general or specialty hospital. Highlight the equipment you can operate and the volume of examinations you have completed independently on your resume.

Assess technologists through a hands-on operation instead of relying only on credentials. Equip teams with AI-assisted devices and regular training to improve efficiency and data quality while making talent easier to retain.

ai_s7_trends: As AI fundus screening and automated measurement spread, technologists are shifting from equipment operators to data quality-control and equipment-management specialists.
Growing demand for myopia prevention and age-related eye care continues to expand ophthalmic technology jobs.
Technologists combining examination performance, AI quality control, and equipment maintenance are becoming the industry's preferred hires.

body: Ophthalmic medical technologists operate equipment for visual acuity, intraocular pressure, visual field, OCT, fundus photography, refraction, and other examinations in eye-care facilities. They collect and analyze eye examination data and assist physicians with diagnosis, preoperative assessment, and postoperative follow-up examinations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can read an OCT image in three seconds, but a technologist must still decide on site how to examine the patient and whether the data are reliable.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三秒读完一张 OCT 图，但「这位患者的检查该怎么做、数据可不可信」，还得技师现场把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医疗技术专家在岗约 17.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.81 万人，净增约 0.93 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代眼科医学技师，但会接管报告判读和部分自动化测量。检查执行、患者配合引导、数据质控、设备管理这些环节依然靠技师——尤其是检查质量直接决定 AI 判读准不准，技师反而是 AI 时代的「数据守门人」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 眼底筛查自动标记病变
智能验光与自动测量设备普及
远程阅片与 AI 辅助诊断联动
检查设备自校准与故障预警
ai_s2_auto: OCT、眼底照相的自动测量与报告生成
视力、眼压数据自动录入系统
检查报告模板与结构化记录
患者预约与检查流程电子化
ai_s3_list: 检查方案判断：特殊病例选什么设备、怎么调参数。
数据质控：发现异常值，判断是病变还是误差。
患者引导：让老人、儿童配合完成高质量检查。
设备维护：仪器状态与校准的把关。
临床配合：理解医生要什么，给得出什么。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明数据判读与报告生成正被 AI 大幅辅助，但检查的执行、质控与患者配合引导仍是技师的核心职责；AI 判读越普及，数据采集质量越重要，技师的价值不降反升。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用 AI 筛查工具、懂数据质控的技师，是医院争着要的「AI 搭档」；只会机械操作、不理解的技师会被设备替代。把「检查 + 质控 + 设备」做成复合能力，就是转型方向。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 眼科医技是医学里性价比不错的赛道：培养周期比医生短、需求稳定增长。建议孩子学眼视光或医技专业，把 OCT、眼底照相这些设备练熟，AI 时代的质控能力是加分项。
把 AI 眼底筛查、自动测量设备用熟，补齐数据质控和特殊病例经验。往资深技师、检查室负责人或视光师方向发展，收入与职业空间都会打开。
有医技、视光或仪器背景的转岗较顺；先考相关资格证，从综合医院或专科医院检查室切入。简历突出你熟练的设备清单和独立完成的检查量。
招技师现场操作一次就知道水平，别只看证书；给团队配 AI 辅助设备和定期培训，技师效率和数据质量都会明显提升，也更容易留住人才。

ai_s7_trends: AI 眼底筛查与自动测量普及，技师从「操作员」转向「数据质控与设备管理」。
近视防控与老龄化眼病需求增长，眼科医技岗位持续扩张。
「检查执行 + AI 质控 + 设备维护」复合技师成为行业首选。

body: 眼科医学技师在眼科医疗机构操作视力、眼压、视野、OCT、眼底照相、验光等检查设备，采集与分析眼部检查数据，协助医生完成诊断、手术前评估与术后随访检查。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能三秒读完一张 OCT 图，但「这位患者的检查该怎么做、数据可不可信」，还得技师现场把关。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Calling systems and labels can accelerate workflows, but technicians still decide which vein to use and how to reassure anxious patients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 139,700 phlebotomists were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 147,500, a net increase of about 7,800 jobs, with about 18,400 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $43,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace phlebotomists, but it will reduce routine steps. Calling and labeling systems accelerate identity verification, shifting work from queue registration toward venipuncture technique, difficult draws, and patient reassurance. Registration-only work faces displacement, while people with steady hands who calm patients become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Venipuncture technique: people provide tactile skill.
Difficult draws: people provide experience.
Patient reassurance: people calm emotions.
Identity safeguards: people bear responsibility.
Emergency response: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates moderately high exposure. Registration and labeling are accelerated, but people still perform venipuncture and reassure patients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Registration and verification actions are being replaced, not venipuncture and reassurance roles. People with steady hands who calm patients become scarcer as outpatient volume grows. Registration-only workers are vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People entering through medical laboratory science should develop technique and communication. Pure registration is shrinking in the AI era, so practice venipuncture early.
Advance from registration to difficult draws + reassurance, and learn quality control.
Highlight training, steady hands, and the departments you have supported.
Do not assess candidates by credentials alone. Evaluate steady hands and the ability to avoid frightening patients. Strong performers deserve stable positions.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service specimen collection becomes widespread.
Outpatient and health-screening volume grows.
People with steady hands who reassure patients are in greater demand.

body: Phlebotomists collect blood samples according to standards, verify patient identity, select puncture sites, perform procedures correctly, and label specimens, ensuring their accurate and safe delivery to the laboratory.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Calling systems and labels can accelerate workflows, but technicians still decide which vein to use and how to reassure anxious patients.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 叫号与标签能提速，但哪根血管该扎、怎么哄紧张的人，还是技师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采血技师在岗约 13.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.75 万人，净增约 0.78 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.84 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采血技师，但会压缩常规环节。叫号与标签系统把身份核对提速，工作从「排队登记」挪向「穿刺手法、难采处理、患者安抚」。真正被挤掉的是只做登记的人，手稳会安抚的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 穿刺手法：手感靠人。
难采处理：经验靠人。
患者安抚：情绪靠人。
身份把关：责任靠人。
突发应对：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——登记与标签被加速，但扎针与安抚仍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「登记核对」动作，不是「穿刺与安抚」的岗位。手稳会安抚的人，反而随门诊量更稀缺。怕的是只会登记。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学检验起步多练手法与沟通，AI 时代纯登记在缩，早点练穿刺。
从「登记」升级成「难采 + 安抚」，学质控。
突出培训与手稳，写清跟过哪些科室。
选人别只看证，要看手稳不会吓患者。骨干值得给稳岗。

ai_s7_trends: 自助采检普及。
门诊体检量增。
手稳会安抚更抢手。

body: 采血技师按规范采集血液样本，核对患者身份、选择穿刺部位、规范操作并标注，确保样本准确安全送达实验室。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 叫号与标签能提速，但哪根血管该扎、怎么哄紧张的人，还是技师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag suspicious areas, but technologists still use their hands to position patients so the image is clear.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 228,000 radiologic technologists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 237,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,800 jobs, with about 12,900 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $77,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace radiologic technologists, but it will take over initial screening and annotation. CADe and quality control flag suspicious areas on routine images first, shifting technologists from finding abnormalities to patient positioning and alignment, patient management, and dose control. Technologists who only follow imaging procedures are most vulnerable, while those skilled in positioning and quality control are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Patient positioning: people adjust the position.
Exposure alignment: people determine precision.
Patient management: people respond to emotions.
Dose control: people protect safety.
Accountability: on-site acquisition staff are responsible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 means this occupation has moderate AI exposure. Initial screening annotations are automated, but positioning and patient management still depend mainly on people, keeping the occupation stable overall.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is not risk-free. Initial screening is accelerated, not the occupation itself. Technologists who position patients, control quality, and manage patient needs will be more secure, while those who only follow procedures will lose tasks to annotation systems.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a medical imaging foundation and practice positioning and protection while studying. Pure image acquisition is shrinking in the AI era, so develop quality control and patient care rather than only learning to press buttons.
Advance from following imaging procedures to positioning + quality control + patient management, learn multiple modalities, and pursue supervisory technologist roles.
Highlight imaging-room and quality-control experience and specify the equipment you operate. Radiation protection credentials are an advantage.
When hiring, look beyond willingness to work to positioning and quality-control ability. Technologists who control dose deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: As CADe and quality control spread, initial screening becomes automated.
Positioning and dose control become core abilities.
Technologists who care for patients are more secure.

body: Radiologic technologists and technicians operate imaging equipment to position patients, perform exposures, and acquire images. They follow radiation protection and safety standards, conduct image quality control, and provide diagnostic physicians with usable images, combining frontline imaging technology with patient care.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can flag suspicious areas, but technologists still use their hands to position patients so the image is clear.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能标出可疑点，但那个体位能不能拍清，还得技师用手对。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年放射技师与技术员在岗约 22.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.78 万人，净增约 0.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代放射技师，但会接手初筛标注。CADe 与质控把常规片的疑似点先标出来，技师的时间从「找点」挪向「摆位对位、患者处置与剂量控制」。真正被挤掉的是只按流程拍的人，能摆位质控的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 患者摆位：体位靠人调。
曝光对位：精度靠人定。
患者处置：情绪靠人对。
剂量控制：安全靠人守。
责任归属：采集现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——初筛标注被自动化，但摆位与患者处置仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于无风险：被加速的是「初筛」，不是「岗位」。会摆位质控、能处置患者的人更稳，纯按流程拍的人会被标注接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 影像打底，在校多练摆位与防护。AI 时代纯拍片在缩，早点练质控和患者照护，别只按按钮。
从「按流程拍」升级成「摆位 + 质控 + 处置」，学多设备，争取往主管技师走。
突出机房与质控经历，写清会哪些设备。有防护证优先。
招人别只看肯干，要看摆位和质控。能控剂量的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: CADe 与质控普及，初筛自动化。
摆位与剂量控制成核心能力。
能照护患者的人更稳。

body: 放射技师与技术员操作影像设备完成患者摆位、曝光与图像采集，执行辐射防护与安全规范，进行图像质控并为诊断医生提供可用影像，是医学影像检查一线的技术与患者照护角。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能标出可疑点，但那个体位能不能拍清，还得技师用手对。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Unmanned and intelligence systems can support reconnaissance, but special forces personnel still determine on-site judgments and team resolve.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military pay follows the Department of Defense rank and years-of-service system. Civilian BLS OES data does not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median. Salary references use Chinese mainland proxy data (Aiqicha and other public sources, sample of 10, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will almost certainly not replace special forces. Drones and intelligence systems can support reconnaissance and decisions, but cannot replace on-site judgment, team coordination, or human resolve. The real change is collaboration between people and unmanned systems, while people remain central to operations and mutual trust.
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Team coordination: people provide trust.
Resilience under pressure: people provide resolve.
Direct action: people accept the danger.
Mutual reliance: people provide the human bond.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in an extremely low AI-exposure military category. Systems provide support, while field work and human resolve depend entirely on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean low risk. The occupation itself is not being replaced, only some repetitive reconnaissance tasks. On-site judgment and team resolve cannot be automated. People who fail to adapt to collaboration between humans and unmanned systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with physical fitness + education. Human resolve and collaboration become more valuable in the AI era, so develop teamwork early.
Advance from individual strength to team leadership + system use and learn unmanned-system collaboration.
Highlight discipline and collaboration and clearly describe mission and team-leadership experience.
Select for resolve and teamwork; dependable core personnel deserve high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Unmanned systems provide support.
Human-unmanned collaboration.
Resolve and collaboration receive greater emphasis.

body: Special Forces lead high-risk reconnaissance and direct-action missions, coordinating plans, equipment, and teams and applying tactics and judgment to complete missions in extreme environments.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Unmanned and intelligence systems can support reconnaissance, but special forces personnel still determine on-site judgments and team resolve.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人与情报系统能辅助侦察，但现场判断和小组意志，还是特种兵定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 几乎不会取代特种部队。无人机与情报系统能辅助侦察与决策，但现场判断、小组协同与意志无法被替代。真正变化是「有人 + 无人」协同，人仍是行动与托付的核心。
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：取舍靠人。
小组协同：信任靠人。
意志抗压：硬靠人。
突入行动：险靠人。
彼此托付：情靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在极低 AI 曝光的军事区——系统是辅助，现场与意志仍完全靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于低风险：被替代的不是岗位，而是个别重复的侦察动作；现场判断与小组意志无法被自动化。怕的是不适应「有人 + 无人」协同的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 体能 + 学历起步，AI 时代意志与协同更值钱，早点练团队。
从「单兵强」升级成「带组 + 用系统」，学无人协同。
突出纪律与协同，写清任务与带组经历。
选人看意志与团队，能托付的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 无人系统辅助。
有人无人协同。
意志与协同更被重。

body: Special Forces（中文名查表缺失）主导高风险侦察与直接行动任务，统筹预案、装备与小组协同，运用战术与判断在极限环境完成任务。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人与情报系统能辅助侦察，但现场判断和小组意志，还是特种兵定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: SCADA can issue automatic alerts and adjust parameters, but a pumper's eyes and hands still determine whether a sample contains sand, whether a valve feels right, and how to respond to a nighttime emergency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,800 wellhead pumpers were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 17,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 900 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 2,000 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $70,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace wellhead pumpers, but it will accelerate control-room monitoring. SCADA and AI automate meter readings, alerts, and initial adjustments, shifting pumpers from watching gauges toward field parameter adjustments, sample assessment, and emergency response. Low-level gauge watching faces the greatest pressure, while people who understand processes and rescue field operations become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: SCADA automatically reads gauges and issues alerts
Automatic initial pressure and flow adjustments
ai_s3_list: Field parameter adjustment: people provide the feel.
Sample assessment: people identify sand content.
Emergency response: people manage leaks.
Equipment maintenance: people assess condition.
Well-condition experience: people set the operational rhythm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in control-room monitoring. Systems accelerate meter readings and initial adjustments, but people retain field adjustments and emergency response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Low-level gauge watching and meter reading are being replaced, not field operations. People who understand processes and rescue field operations become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only copy readings without thinking face the risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in petroleum or electromechanics and gain hands-on SCADA experience during school. Pure gauge watching is shrinking in the AI era, so develop parameter-adjustment skills early.
Advance from meter reading to parameter adjustment and emergency response, learn predictive maintenance, and work toward becoming a wellsite supervisor.
Highlight well-duty and emergency cases and specify the equipment types you have handled. Oilfields value steadiness and accountability.
Do not hire solely for gauge-reading ability; assess process knowledge. Pumpers who can rescue field operations deserve strong allowances.

ai_s7_trends: SCADA and AI improve efficiency, shrinking gauge watching.
Digitalization of mature oilfields preserves demand.
Pumpers skilled in parameter adjustment and emergency response are in greater demand.

body: Wellhead pumpers monitor wellhead equipment and pump units for oil, water, and gas wells; adjust pressure and flow; collect and test samples; record operating data; and work with SCADA to maintain safe, stable production at the wellsite.
career_ai_description_block.heading: SCADA can issue automatic alerts and adjust parameters, but a pumper's eyes and hands still determine whether a sample contains sand, whether a valve feels right, and how to respond to a nighttime emergency.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: SCADA 能自动报警和调参，但那管样含不含砂、阀门手感对不对、夜里突发怎么救，还是泵工的眼和手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年井口泵操作员在岗约 1.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.79 万人，岗位净减约 0.09 万个，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代井口泵操作员，但会加速监盘。SCADA 与 AI 把抄表、报警和初调自动化，泵工从「看表」挪向「现场调参、取样判断、应急处置」。真正被挤掉的是低阶看表，懂流程能救现场的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场调参：手感靠人。
取样判断：含砂靠人。
应急处置：泄漏靠人救。
设备保养：状态靠人看。
井况经验：节奏靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的监盘区——抄表与初调被系统加速，但调参与应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「低阶看表与抄表」动作，不是「现场操作」的岗位。懂流程、能救现场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只抄表不思考的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 石油/机电打底，在校多摸 SCADA。AI 时代纯看表在缩，早点练调参。
从「抄表」升级成「做调参 + 应急」，学预测维护，争取当井站长。
突出值井与应急案例，写清跟过哪些机型。油田看重稳和兜。
选人别只看会看表，要看懂不懂流程。能救现场的泵工，值得给高补贴。

ai_s7_trends: SCADA 与 AI 提效，看表缩。
老油田数字化留需求。
懂调参应急的更抢手。

body: 井口泵操作员监控油水气井的井口设备与泵机组，调节压力流量、取样化验、记录运行数据，配合 SCADA 保障井场安全稳产，是油气开采现场的一线操作。
career_ai_description_block.heading: SCADA 能自动报警和调参，但那管样含不含砂、阀门手感对不对、夜里突发怎么救，还是泵工的眼和手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Generative AI can draft, but authors still decide what to write, why to write it, and what good writing means.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 135,400 writers and authors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 140,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,900 jobs, with roughly 13,400 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $72,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace authors, but it will squeeze formulaic writing. Generative AI accelerates first drafts and mass production, shifting authors from producing standard copy to choosing topics, conducting research, exercising editorial judgment, and establishing a distinctive voice. People who only produce formulaic content will be displaced; those with originality and judgment will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Original judgment: people decide what to write.
Research and facts: people verify what is true.
Structural control: people shape the pacing.
Establishing a voice: people define the tone.
Value judgments: people choose the position.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 means this occupation sits in a moderately high-exposure area of writing: systems accelerate formulaic copy, but originality and judgment still leave an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces the act of producing formulaic copy, not the occupation of creating content. People with originality and judgment can become even scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only produce formulaic content are the vulnerable ones.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with language, literature, or communications and practice research and voice development. Formulaic writing is shrinking in the AI era, so cultivate originality early.
Advance from writing copy to choosing topics and establishing a voice. Learn research and distribution, and work toward a signature body of work.
Showcase your portfolio and subject-matter specialization, making clear which areas you have written about.
Do not hire based on output volume alone; look for judgment. Writers who can establish a distinctive voice deserve higher rates.

ai_s7_trends: Generative AI adoption is reducing formulaic writing.
Originality and a distinctive voice create opportunities.
People with strong judgment are in greater demand.

body: Writers and authors create fiction and nonfiction, coordinating topics, structure, research, and expression to communicate information, ideas, and aesthetic value through words.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Generative AI can draft, but authors still decide what to write, why to write it, and what good writing means.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 生成式能写初稿，但写什么、为什么写、什么算好，还是作者定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年作家与作者在岗约 13.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.03 万人，净增约 0.49 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.23 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代作者，但会压缩套路稿。生成式把初稿和量产提速，作者从「写标准稿」挪向「定选题、做研究、把把关、立声音」。真正被挤掉的是只产套路内容的人，有原创和判断的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 原创判断：写什么靠人。
研究与事实：真靠人核。
结构把控：节奏靠人。
声音立住：调性靠人。
价值取舍：立场靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的写作区——套路稿被系统加速，但原创与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「写套路稿」动作，不是「内容创作」的岗位。有原创和判断的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只产套路内容的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中文/传播起步多练研究和声音，AI 时代纯套路在缩，早点练原创。
从「写稿」升级成「定选题 + 立声音」，学研究和渠道，争取代表作。
突出作品和垂直领域，写清写过哪些方向。
选人别只看产量，要看有没有判断。能立声音的人值得给高稿酬。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式普及，套路稿缩。
原创与声音带来机会。
有判断的人更抢手。

body: 作家与作者创作虚构与非虚构内容，统筹选题、结构、研究与表达，运用文字传达信息、观点与审美。
